call_points.text: No numeric guidance given; management expects Fairfax approvals in the next 2 to 3 months.
Fairfax would become promoter alongside existing promoters and nominate two directors on completion.
Finance cost rose to ₹60 Cr from ₹40 Cr a year ago on a larger MTF book.
Other income rose ₹90 Cr, mainly mark-to-market gains on BSE shares.
A ₹124 Cr income-tax demand from the January 2025 search is under appeal.
AIF and PMS AUM of about ₹4,400 Cr; income sits under financial product distribution.
Net collections were about ₹3,675 Cr; management called slower AUM growth a one-off.
Fewer than ten relationship managers added in the quarter.
Institutional and investment banking income of about ₹200 Cr split roughly 50-50 to 60-40 between the two.
Distribution assets reached around ₹52,000 crores, driven by mutual funds, AIF, PMS, and fixed income products.
Finance costs rose 45% YoY in Q4 due to an increasing margin trade funding (MTF) book.

operating_notes.text: Two wholly owned subsidiaries received income tax demands of ₹6.82 Cr and ₹49.46 Cr for the block period April 1, 2018 to February 3, 2025; the company plans to appeal.
Postal ballot closed 24 April 2026 with 77.97% of 31,14,13,794 shares voted; both special resolutions passed with over 99% in favour.
FIH Mauritius Investments held 8,46,41,445 shares (27.18%) pre-issue and would hold 14,17,84,302 shares (38.47%) post-issue; affiliate HWIC Asia Fund holds 3.33%.
Received income tax demand of ₹68.07 Cr for the block period April 1, 2018 to March 25, 2025.
FIH Mauritius Investments to infuse ₹2,000 Cr via preferential issue of 5.71 Cr shares at ₹350 each, taking its stake to 38.47% and assuming joint promoter status.
Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary IIFL Capital (IFSC) Limited in GIFT City with authorised capital of ₹10 Cr.
CRISIL rated ₹175 Cr long-term bank facilities AA- on watch positive, ₹2,025 Cr short-term facilities and ₹3,050 Cr commercial paper A1+ reaffirmed.
Total margin deposits with stock exchanges were ₹5,221.71 Cr at March 31, 2026, up from ₹4,018.63 Cr a year earlier.
Aggregate outstanding borrowings were about ₹1,745 Cr as on the date of the EGM notice.
SEBI cancelled IIFL Capital Services' Portfolio Manager registration (No. INP000002213) following the slump sale of the PMS business to ICAML.
AIF and PMS AUM of about ₹4,400 Cr, with income booked under financial product distribution.
Average daily turnover ₹3,15,780 Cr in Q1FY27, of which F&O ₹3,12,480 Cr and cash ₹3,300 Cr.
Fewer than ten relationship managers added in Q1FY27.
Discontinued using existing platform and new version under implementation; agreements with third-party sellers executed.

timeline.summary: Q4FY25 results (consolidated): revenue ₹537.14 Cr, net profit ₹128.03 Cr.
NSE imposed a penalty of ₹7.68 lakh on IIFL Capital Services for client code modification.
Exchange sought clarification on news regarding Fairfax increasing its stake via preferential allotment.
On April 22, 2026, IIFL Capital Services clarified to the stock exchanges that there was no reportable event under Regulation 30 regarding media reports of Fairfax increasing its stake.
IIFL Capital Services subsidiaries received income tax assessment demands totaling ₹56.24 Cr.
On 28 April 2026 IIFL Capital reported that shareholders passed; by postal ballot; special resolutions raising the Section 180(1)(c) borrowing limits and the Section 180(1)(a) limits
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹644.3 Cr (+20.0% YoY), net profit ₹115.11 Cr (-10.1% YoY).
IIFL Capital Services Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results held on May 05, 2026, at 12:00 PM, signed by Meghal Shah.
IIFL Capital Services approved a ₹2,000 Cr preferential issue of equity shares to FIH Mauritius Investments, triggering an open offer and change of control.
IIFL Capital Services announced a ₹2,000 Cr preferential allotment to Fairfax India at ₹350 per share, raising its stake to over 51%.
IIFL Capital Services received an income tax demand of ₹68.07 Cr for the block period from April 2018 to March 2025.
IIFL Capital Services issued an EGM notice to approve a ₹2,000 Cr preferential allotment of equity shares to FIH Mauritius Investments at ₹350 per share.
IIFL Capital Services hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting flat full-year revenue and rising finance costs.
IIFL Capital Services incorporated its wholly owned subsidiary IIFL Capital (IFSC) Limited in GIFT City with an authorised capital of ₹10 Crore.

CRISIL placed IIFL Capital's ₹175 Cr long-term bank facilities on watch with positive implications at CRISIL AA-, while reaffirming ₹2,025 Cr short-term facilities and ₹3,050 Cr commercial paper at CRISIL A1+.

IIFL Capital issued a corrigendum to its EGM notice on May 21, 2026, detailing objects for the ₹2,000 Cr preferential issue to FIH Mauritius: ₹1,000 Cr for debt repayment, ₹500 Cr for exchange margins and ₹500 Cr for general corporate purposes.
SEBI cancelled IIFL Capital Services' Portfolio Manager registration on May 20, 2026, following the business transfer to its subsidiary.

IIFL Capital held its first FY27 EGM on June 01, 2026, to vote on the ₹2,000 Cr preferential issue to FIH Mauritius and on amending its Articles of Association; voting results were to be filed separately.
IIFL Capital Services Limited’s 1/2026-27 EGM held on June 1, 2026, passed all resolutions with requisite majority via remote e-voting and in-person electronic voting.

On 24 July 2026 IIFL Capital's Q1FY27 call reported revenue flat at ₹631 Cr and operational PBT down 9% YoY to ₹149 Cr, with the ₹2,000 Cr Fairfax preferential issue approved by shareholders but awaiting regulatory approvals.
On 14 October 2026, IIFL Capital Services announced receipt of a SEBI adjudication order imposing a ₹2 lakh penalty regarding OBPP operations.
